name: TextOCR: Large-Scale End-to-End Arbitrary-Shaped Scene Text Benchmark
description: TextOCR is a large-scale scene text detection and recognition benchmark developed by Facebook AI Research (FAIR) and presented at CVPR 2021. Designed to address arbitrary-shaped, curved, oriented, and small text in complex real-world scenes, TextOCR provides fine-grained polygonal annotations for 900,000+ text instances across 28,134 high-resolution natural images from the Open Images dataset (v0.1: 21,778 train, 3,124 validation, 3,232 test). The dataset emphasizes full-scene reading with a high density of annotated text per image (averaging over 32 words per image), dramatically exceeding existing scene text benchmarks in word count, vocabulary breadth, and geometric distortion complexity.
